scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && node -e "if (require('fs').existsSync('frontend/package.json')) { require('child_process').execSync('npm --prefix frontend install', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }"
